events.factual_description: Godiego's official 50th-anniversary site and SGC HALL ARIAKE confirm SGC presents Godiego FEST 2026 on Saturday, October 10, 2026, with doors at 4:00 PM and the performance beginning at 5:00 PM. The event marks Godiego's 50th anniversary year and features the current five-member band—Mickie Yoshino, Yukihide Takekawa, Steve Fox, Tommy Snyder and Yoji Yoshizawa—alongside support member Kazuyuki Takekoshi, Godiego Horns, THE SOULMATICS TSM Gospel Ensemble, and guest artists Masaaki Sakai, Char, Yasuyuki Okamura, Kazuyoshi Saito, Okamura Kazuyoshi, Seiji Kameda, Mummy-D and EXILE B HAPPY. Reserved seats are ¥14,000 and U-20 seats are ¥5,000; general sale is scheduled to open September 5, 2026 at 10:00 AM through eplus, Pia and Lawson Ticket.

en.why_it_matters: Godiego's 50th year gets a one-day Tokyo festival rather than another standard tour stop: the current band expands outward through Char, Yasuyuki Okamura, Kazuyoshi Saito, Seiji Kameda, Mummy-D, choir and horns. That turns the anniversary into a map of how a durable piece of Japanese rock history still connects to later generations and adjacent musical worlds.
en.trip_verdict: If Greater Tokyo is in play, actively make room and let Ariake anchor the day. I would choose this over a routine tour stop for the anniversary lineup, but I would not rebuild an entire Japan trip around it while Godiego remains active across a broader 50th-anniversary tour.

es.why_it_matters: El año 50 de Godiego se convierte aquí en un festival de un solo día en Tokio, no en otra parada normal de gira: la banda actual se abre hacia Char, Yasuyuki Okamura, Kazuyoshi Saito, Seiji Kameda, Mummy-D, coro y metales. El aniversario funciona así como un mapa de cómo una pieza duradera de la historia del rock japonés sigue conectando con generaciones posteriores y con otros lenguajes musicales.
es.trip_verdict: Si Greater Tokyo está en juego, sí le haría espacio y dejaría que Ariake ancle el día. Escogería esta fecha sobre una parada rutinaria de la gira por el cartel del aniversario, pero no reconstruiría un viaje entero a Japón alrededor de ella mientras Godiego sigue activo en una gira más amplia de 50 años.
